name: ai
description: LLM helper library — provider adapters (Anthropic, OpenAI), prompt registry, structured outputs, tool-calling, RAG, and an experimental agent loop. Pluggable LLMProvider interface; concrete adapters are opt-in (install only the SDK you use).
postInstall: Install the SDK for the providers you need: `npm i @anthropic-ai/sdk` and/or `npm i openai`
Import { type LLMProvider } from '@sixthsummit/ship-api/libraries/ai' and the adapter you want (e.g. AnthropicAdapter)
Construct the adapter with your API key: `const llm = new AnthropicAdapter({ apiKey: env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY })`
All adapters share the same `LLMProvider` interface — swap providers without changing call sites
